key_insight: Training language models on structured experimental evidence enabled stronger perovskite reasoning and guided a contact-material choice that outperformed the expert-preferred alternative.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI can help prioritize perovskite device experiments, with the selected contact yielding 27.05% efficiency and 96.74% retention after 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85°C.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 training articles.
Adapt OpenPerov using links among experimental strategies, controls, observations and mechanisms.
Refine selected responses with retrieved evidence and experimentally test a K-based self-assembled monolayer analogue.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; retrieval-assisted OpenPerov Pro increased Scientific Mastery from 87.6 to 89.1.
watch_item: Dark thermal ageing and one demonstrated contact-selection task do not establish operational stability or generalization across device architectures.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
